part_numbers_or_os_ids: other common OS IDs for Holden/GM LS1 2001-2004
protocol: J1850 VPW @ 10.4 kbps (primary), some CAN variants

flash_memory_map.cal_b: Calibration block B (64 KB blocks typical)

checksum.description: Each 64KB cal block summed as 16-bit big-endian words must total 0x0000. Correction value patched in designated location after modifications. Existing Rust implementation in src-tauri/src/checksum.rs (validate_checksums / correct_and_validate_checksums). GM-P01-P59-checksum-plugin.dll is the reference plugin.
checksum.routine: Ported and active in checksum.rs - uses CAL_IMAGE_SIZE, CorrectedCal struct

security_access.reference: GmKeys.cs + security.rs (Level 1 for read/DTC, Level 2 for flash programming)

maps_and_xdf.description: Full TunerPro XDF with tables for spark advance, fuel VE, idle, etc. Addresses and scalings defined. Can be imported or manually ported to app map catalogue.
maps_and_xdf.kernel_for_flash: Kernel-P01.bin (7.7 KB) - uploaded to RAM for flash ops

notes: Already heavily integrated in Rust backend (vpw.rs, security.rs, checksum.rs, flash.rs, pid_decode.rs, dtc.rs). This DB entry centralizes metadata so frontend/app can auto-detect P01 on connect, load correct checksum routine, and reference XDF/maps. Supports Holden specific + GM variants. Use with PCM Hammer style workflows for affordable flashing.
